=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:lines 266-382 (solc_install.py:install) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The script fetches list.json from binaries.soliditylang.org over HTTPS and trusts it to provide the SHA256 checksums for the solc binaries, but it never checks list.json itself against a trusted hardcoded hash or signature.
  WHY: If the binaries.soliditylang.org server is compromised, an attacker can serve a malicious list.json with the hash of a malicious binary, and the script will download and install a compromised compiler (source severity MAJOR).
- tests/test_codex_isolated_exec.py:test_image_context_with_solc_versions_adds_verified_install | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The test checks that solc_install.py is written to the Docker build context, but it never runs the installer during an image build or execution.
  WHY: Installer logic errors (wrong directory paths, permission issues, install failures) are caught only at runtime during image construction, not in the CI test suite (source severity MAJOR).
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:is_amd64_elf (line 306) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The ELF header check on downloaded binaries verifies only the ELF magic, 64-bit, and the AMD64 architecture.
  WHY: A crafted binary that meets these few constraints but is not a working solc binary could pass the check and fail when invoked later (source severity NIT).
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:fetch (line 258) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The download timeout is hardcoded to 60 seconds.
  WHY: A slow network connection could fail the image build even though the download would finish given more time (source severity NIT).
- tests/test_codex_isolated_exec.py:`_image_context()` lines 817-828 (PATH prepend at line 822), contrasted with the executability probe in `test_non_x86_64_runner_warns_and_build_without_solc()` lines 1030-1034 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Every `_image_context` call prepends the `_fake_uname` shim to PATH, but only the aarch64 test checks that the shim can execute; the positive solc tests (`test_image_context_with_solc_versions_adds_verified_install`, `test_solc_versions_are_deduplicated_and_capped_after_dedupe`, `test_solc_build_arg_is_forwarded_only_when_opted_in`) have no such guard.
  WHY: On a non-x86_64 runner with a noexec `tmp_path`, PATH lookup falls through to the real `/usr/bin/uname`, the helper emits `unsupported_arch` and omits solc, and the positive assertions fail spuriously; this cannot happen on this repo's x86_64 CI (source severity NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
